summary: Vertiv Holdings Co, through subsidiaries Vertiv Corporation (Buyer) and Vultra Merger Sub, filed an 8-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire Utility Innovation Holdings, Inc. (Target) via merger. Aggregate consideration includes approximately $1.45 billion upfront cash at closing, subject to working capital, debt, and expense adjustments, plus up to $1.15 billion in potential cash earnouts tied to EBITDA targets in two tranches. The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to HSR waiting period and customary conditions. Funding will come from existing resources. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and earnout performance.
